why_agent_cannot: connect a wallet and approve the signature
what_human_must_do: Connect a burner wallet and approve the signature yourself.
steps_from_source: 1 Step 1 : Open the homepage Go to the Picasso Markets homepage and read the headline, "The Stock Market. Reimagined.", along with the ticker row beneath it.
2 Step 2 : Find the waitlist button The homepage has a button labelled "Join the beta waitlist". The page does not explain what the button does or when anything opens.
3 Step 3 : Find the username button The same page has a button labelled "Claim your username". The homepage does not describe what the username is used for.
4 Step 4 : Check the homepage again Return to the Picasso Markets homepage later to see whether anything on it has changed.
